instructions: For each independent query, decide whether the named skill should activate from its candidate description. Judge task intent, not isolated keywords. Return id and activate boolean for every case. Do not execute any requested workflow.

skills.name: arquiteto-de-empresa
skills.description: Create or document an entire company as an OKF Markdown knowledge bundle, including a requested guided founder interview. Not for a single business definition, a quick business idea, or editing one existing company document.

skills.name: chief-ai-officer-advisor
skills.description: Chief AI Officer advisory for startups: model build-vs-buy decisions (API vs fine-tune vs in-house), AI risk classification under EU AI Act + US state patchwork, AI cost economics (API-to-self-hosted breakeven), and AI team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to call an API or fine-tune, classifying AI use cases for regulatory risk, calculating when self-hosting pays off, sequencing AI hires. Not for implementing ML code, a general model definition, or merely mentioning a model name.

skills.name: chief-data-officer-advisor
skills.description: Chief Data Officer advisory for startups: AI training data rights and consent provenance, data product strategy (warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, build-vs-buy), B2B customer-data-as-asset valuation and M&A readiness, data team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to train models on customer data, choosing data architecture, valuing data for fundraising or M&A, sequencing data hires. Not for tactical data engineering, a data-term definition, or merely mentioning a database.

skills.name: board-prep
skills.description: Rehearse a founder/executive for adversarial board or investor questions with numerical mastery and narrative defense. Not for building slide artifacts alone, ordinary status updates, or defining a board term.

skills.name: challenge
skills.description: Run a requested pre-mortem or challenge a consequential business plan before commitment, identifying assumptions and dependencies. Not for every plan, a small reversible task, or a simple request to explain risk.

skills.name: general-counsel-advisor
skills.description: General Counsel advisory for startups: contract review (MSA, SaaS, NDA, DPA, employment), IP strategy, term sheet decoding, and regulatory landscape mapping. Use when reviewing any contract or term sheet, deciding when to engage outside counsel, defining IP strategy, evaluating regulatory exposure (HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, fintech). Not for a one-off legal-term definition or merely mentioning a regulation without a legal review/decision.

skills.name: board-deck-builder
skills.description: Build or restructure an actual board/investor update deck, quarterly review or fundraising narrative artifact. Not for a short investor message, a definition, or adversarial rehearsal without a deck deliverable.

skills.name: ceo-advisor
skills.description: Executive leadership guidance for strategic decision-making, organizational development, and stakeholder management. Use when planning strategy, preparing board presentations, managing investors, developing organizational culture, making executive decisions, fundraising. Not for single financial calculations, basic business definitions or a specialist task solely because CEO/strategy is mentioned.

skills.name: cfo-advisor
skills.description: Financial leadership for startups and scaling companies. Financial modeling, unit economics, fundraising strategy, cash management, and board financial packages. Use when building financial models, analyzing unit economics, planning fundraising, managing cash runway, preparing board materials. Not for a standalone calculation, a definition of CAC/LTV/runway, or personal stock/subscription analysis.

skills.name: change-management
skills.description: Framework for rolling out organizational changes without chaos. Covers the ADKAR model adapted for startups, communication templates, resistance patterns, and change fatigue management. Handles process changes, org restructures, strategy pivots, and culture changes. Use when announcing a reorg, switching tools, pivoting strategy, killing a product, changing leadership. Not for a routine code/tool setting change or a definition without an organizational rollout.

skills.name: chief-of-staff
skills.description: Route an executive decision when the needed advisor is unclear or coordinate an explicitly multi-domain C-suite analysis. Not a mandatory entry point for a known advisor, a single-domain answer, or a simple business definition; a board meeting needs its own applicable trigger.

skills.name: chro-advisor
skills.description: People leadership for scaling companies. Hiring strategy, compensation design, org structure, culture, and retention. Use when building hiring plans, designing comp frameworks, restructuring teams, managing performance, building culture. Not for a one-off HR definition, individual scheduling, or merely mentioning headcount.

skills.name: ciso-advisor
skills.description: Security leadership for growth-stage companies. Risk quantification in dollars, compliance roadmap (SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA/GDPR), security architecture strategy, incident response leadership, and board-level security reporting. Use when building security programs, justifying security budget, selecting compliance frameworks, managing incidents, assessing vendor risk. Not for a security-term definition or a routine code fix without security-program or incident leadership scope.

skills.name: cmo-advisor
skills.description: Marketing leadership for scaling companies. Brand positioning, growth model design, marketing budget allocation, and marketing org design. Use when designing brand strategy, selecting growth models (PLG vs sales-led vs community-led), allocating marketing budgets, building marketing teams. Not for drafting one social post, defining CAC/LTV, or merely mentioning marketing.

skills.name: company-os
skills.description: The meta-framework for how a company runs — the connective tissue between all C-suite roles. Covers operating system selection (EOS, Scaling Up, OKR-native, hybrid), accountability charts, scorecards, meeting pulse, issue resolution, and 90-day rocks. Use when setting up company operations, selecting a management framework, designing meeting rhythms, building accountability systems, implementing OKRs. Not for an operating-system software question or a one-off OKR definition.

skills.name: competitive-intel
skills.description: Systematic competitor tracking that feeds CMO positioning, CRO battlecards, and CPO roadmap decisions. Use when analyzing competitors, building sales battlecards, tracking market moves, positioning against alternatives. Not for a single fact about another company, a definition, or unrelated web research.

skills.name: context-engine
skills.description: Load or maintain company context needed by an active C-suite advisory task, including privacy checks before external use. Not a trigger to start advising, launch onboarding, or collect company data for a simple definition; missing/stale context alone does not authorize an interview.

skills.name: coo-advisor
skills.description: Operations leadership for scaling companies. Process design, OKR execution, operational cadence, and scaling playbooks. Use when designing operations, setting up OKRs, building processes, scaling teams, analyzing bottlenecks, planning operational cadence. Not for a one-off operational definition, ordinary task execution or a single software-process bug.

skills.name: cpo-advisor
skills.description: Product leadership for scaling companies. Product vision, portfolio strategy, product-market fit, and product org design. Use when setting product vision, managing a product portfolio, measuring PMF, designing product teams, prioritizing at the portfolio level, reporting to the board on product. Not for implementing one feature, a one-off PMF definition or a narrow UI change.

skills.name: cro-advisor
skills.description: Revenue leadership for B2B SaaS companies. Revenue forecasting, sales model design, pricing strategy, net revenue retention, and sales team scaling. Use when designing the revenue engine, setting quotas, modeling NRR, evaluating pricing, building board forecasts. Not for a one-off ARR/NRR definition, a simple arithmetic question or an unrelated use of CRO.

skills.name: cs-onboard
skills.description: Run the company-context interview when the user requests initial C-suite setup, /cs:setup, /cs:update or a context refresh. Not merely because context is absent or older than 90 days, and not for an isolated business question.

skills.name: cto-advisor
skills.description: Technical leadership guidance for engineering teams, architecture decisions, and technology strategy. Use when assessing technical debt, scaling engineering teams, evaluating technologies, making architecture decisions, establishing engineering metrics. Not for a small code/debugging task, a technical-term definition or merely mentioning architecture.

skills.name: culture-architect
skills.description: Build, measure, and evolve company culture as operational behavior — not wall posters. Covers mission/vision/values workshops, values-to-behaviors translation, culture code creation, culture health assessment, and cultural rituals by stage. Use when building company values, assessing culture health, designing cultural rituals, creating culture codes, handling culture clashes. Not for a dictionary meaning of culture/values or a single wording edit without culture-design scope.

skills.name: founder-coach
skills.description: Personal leadership development for founders and first-time CEOs. Covers founder archetype identification, delegation frameworks, energy management, CEO calendar audits, leadership style evolution, blind spot identification, imposter syndrome, founder mental health, and succession planning. Use when a founder feels like the bottleneck, struggles to delegate, is burning out, transitioning from IC to executive, managing a board. Not for a definition of delegation/burnout or ordinary task delegation without founder coaching needs.

skills.name: internal-narrative
skills.description: Build and maintain one coherent company story across all audiences — employees, investors, customers, candidates, and partners. Detects narrative contradictions and ensures the same truth is framed for each audience's needs. Use when preparing investor updates, all-hands presentations, board communications, recruiting narratives, crisis communications. Not for a short isolated message or a storytelling definition without cross-audience company-narrative work.

skills.name: org-health-diagnostic
skills.description: Assess overall organizational health across business functions with a requested diagnostic or evidence of cross-functional dysfunction. Not for service/server health, a single operational metric, or a general definition of organizational health.

skills.name: scenario-war-room
skills.description: Model a consequential business scenario with interacting risks cascading across several functions. Not for every what-if question, a simple calculation with two variables, or a single-assumption stress test.

skills.name: strategic-alignment
skills.description: Cascades strategy from boardroom to individual contributor. Detects and fixes misalignment between company goals and team execution. Covers strategy articulation, cascade mapping, orphan goal detection, silo identification, communication gap analysis, and realignment protocols. Use when teams are pulling in different directions, OKRs don't connect, departments optimize locally at company expense. Not for CSS/text alignment, a definition of strategy or a single routine task.

skills.name: ultra-adversarial-verify-skill
skills.description: Challenge material claims in a completed deliverable, high-risk migration or release, or perform a requested adversarial review. Not for every completion message, a routine test run, or a simple factual answer.

skills.name: ultra-agent-eval-skill
skills.description: Audit a completed agent implementation for unsupported completion claims, changed files, weakened tests and reproducible evidence. Not for every agent reply or routine verification; use adversarial-verify for a general report or non-agent deliverable.

skills.name: ultra-browser-skill
skills.description: Control web pages for navigation, forms or extraction using grounded browser observations. Not for a simple URL fetch, a conceptual web question, or a dedicated JEV/recipe workflow handled by ultra-browser-v2-skill.

skills.name: browser-stealth-timing
skills.description: Add human-like timing to a multi-step browser flow with an observed or relevant bot-detection risk. Not for localhost/internal tools, a single page read, ordinary browsing without that risk, or explaining browser timing.

skills.name: ultra-browser-v2-skill
skills.description: Executar recipes revisadas, navegação visível com LLM+JEV e snapshots DOM, ou revisar sua evidência de execução. Não usar para leitura simples de URL, dúvidas sobre navegadores ou navegação comum sem esse harness; não concede acesso ao judge privado.

skills.name: ultra-chrome-assistente-skill
skills.description: Control the active Chrome session through the installed Chrome Assistant extension, WebSocket bridge and sidepanel. Not for general browser navigation, Chrome settings questions, or direct CDP control without that extension.

skills.name: ultra-chrome-devtools-skill
skills.description: Investigar performance web com traces, Lighthouse, rede ou console pelo Chrome DevTools MCP. Não usar para navegação comum, criação de interface ou explicação pontual de métricas sem diagnóstico solicitado.

skills.name: ultra-chrome-stealth-navigator-skill
skills.description: Attach through CDP to an existing Chrome profile when an authorized workflow needs its session or has encountered bot-detection blocking. Not for ordinary page fetches, extension-bridge control, or a general explanation of Cloudflare/CDP.

skills.name: ultra-confluence-docs-skill
skills.description: Create or revise a structured ADR, runbook, architecture document, technical specification or knowledge-transfer handoff. Not for quick notes, a one-off explanation of these formats, ticket management or code implementation.

skills.name: ultra-create-skill
skills.description: Create, repair, review or evaluate an AgentSkill and its discovery description or bundled resources. Not for finding an existing skill, editing project-only configuration, or explaining a topic without requesting a reusable skill.

skills.name: ultra-dom-engine-skill
skills.description: Use DOM-engine extraction in complex dynamic forms when native browser observations cannot reliably identify interactive targets. Not for simple page reads, ordinary navigation with adequate native refs, or a conceptual DOM question.

skills.name: ultra-drawio-skill
skills.description: Create, edit, validate or export draw.io XML artifacts, including flowcharts, ER/UML, sequence, network and cloud diagrams. Not for a diagram requested only in Mermaid/SVG, or a one-off explanation of diagram notation.

skills.name: ultra-find-skill
skills.description: Find, inventory or compare installed or remote agent skills, or check for a reusable capability before authoring one. Not for ordinary how-to questions, general knowledge, directly invoking a known skill, or editing a skill already identified.

skills.name: ultra-gemini-image-skill
skills.description: Generate images specifically through the Gemini web UI, or recover its broken blob download using CDP extraction. Not for general image generation with another available provider, image analysis, or questions about Gemini.

skills.name: ultra-grok-image-skill
skills.description: Generate an image specifically with Grok on X and retrieve its media attachment. Not for a generic image request without a Grok preference, analyzing an existing image, text-only Grok questions, or publishing an X post.

skills.name: ultra-live-state-truth-skill
skills.description: Verify a mutable operational fact against its authoritative source when an action or status answer depends on current state. Not for timeless definitions, arithmetic, historical facts fixed to a supplied snapshot, or an unrelated broad system audit.

skills.name: ultra-memory-hygiene-skill
skills.description: Decide what to persist or revise in agent memory, consolidate durable notes, or remove stale/duplicate stored context. Not for a read-only memory lookup, temporary task output, or explaining memory concepts without a persistence decision.

skills.name: ultra-memory-skill
skills.description: Retrieve or maintain recorded workspace context through SSC routing, segmented memory and evidence/integrity checks. Not for general knowledge questions, source-code lookup, or explaining LLM memory without consulting stored context.

skills.name: ultra-models-skill
skills.description: Audit configured model catalogs, current free-model availability, dead IDs, provider health or fallback routing with dated evidence. Not for a general explanation of LLMs, an unrelated meaning of model, or an abstract model comparison without a catalog/operational decision.

skills.name: ultra-perplexity-pro-bridge-skill
skills.description: Search or run a model session specifically through Perplexity web when requested or selected for that workflow. Not for every web search, a simple URL fetch, or general questions about Perplexity.

skills.name: ultra-pipeline-resilience-skill
skills.description: Coordinate a long-running multi-step workflow needing durable state, interruption recovery or agent/external-dependency handoffs. Not for short sequential tasks, ordinary questions, or merely mentioning pipeline, architecture or implementation.

skills.name: ultra-plan-gate-skill
skills.description: Establish an evidence-backed plan before nontrivial multi-file edits, uncertain migrations or consequential external changes. Not for a typo fix, a bounded routine command, a read-only status lookup or a conceptual question.

skills.name: ultra-plan-with-diagrams-skill
skills.description: Produce an implementation plan, roadmap or visual brainstorming when architecture/flow diagrams materially clarify the requested work. Not for every multi-step task, a conceptual answer, review-only work or a plan without useful diagrams.

skills.name: ultra-powershell-skill
skills.description: Write, repair or execute PowerShell/Windows automation involving native CLI quoting, paths, encoding or process lifecycle. Not merely because the host is Windows, or for a generic Windows question with no scripting task.

skills.name: ultra-provider-health-skill
skills.description: Investigate provider/client contract drift, endpoint/header changes, rate-limit changes or an evidenced model-provider failure. Not for generic model selection, an unrelated application timeout or a full catalog refresh without a provider incident.

skills.name: ultra-qa-testing-skill
skills.description: Execute a structured web-app QA suite or requested exploratory test with pass/fail evidence, screenshots and a report. Not for a one-off browser check, unit-test command, static code review, or explaining testing terminology.

skills.name: ultra-ruthless-editor-skill
skills.description: Tighten an existing technical or executive draft while preserving facts, uncertainty, constraints and actions. Not for every newly composed answer, fact-checking without an editing request, or a simple definition.

skills.name: ultra-x-stealth-skill
skills.description: Publish authorized posts or threads on X through the stealth fallback when x-poster is blocked or that path is explicitly requested. Not for drafting without publication, reading an X link, ordinary x-poster success, or generic anti-detection questions.
